text:
ida: CI red on main: //runtime:scheduler_init_test hung in CI runner (~2m), 4/6 attempts. stack shows worker waiting on 'bootstrap_condvar'. Anyone seen this flake?
ci-bot: CI failure report: job 4521 - https://ci.internal/reports/4521 — test hung (timeout). logs attached.
ravi: queued a rerun (job 4522). grabbing logs from 4521 now. can someone try a local repeat? :eyes:
alex_h: on it. note: PR 2345 changed scheduler startup ordering, might be related — start/stop ordering race. can you paste the exact stack or the thread dump?
kevin: fwiw saw a similar hang locally on macos with fast timers. disabling timer coalescing made it repro more often. maybe a timing window.
sam: quick local repro command that increases hit rate:
```
./bazelisk test //runtime:scheduler_init_test --test_output=all --runs_per_test=20
```
outputs: `worker waiting on bootstrap_condvar` after `Scheduler::start()` line. attached trimmed log snippet.
ravi: logs from 4521: attached gist https://gists.internal/abc123 — shows waiter blocked in wait_for with deadline, notifier executed earlier. I'm starting a 100x run with tracing.
ida: thanks. repro is intermittent but consistent when runs_per_test >= 10. any easy mitigations we can try before bisect?
alex_h: quick experiment: add a full memory barrier in Scheduler::start() before notifying threads, and flip the notify to use notify_all instead of notify_one. if that reduces hits it's ordering. can someone apply locally for a smoke?
kevin: trying patch now (notify_all + fence). running 200 repeats. will report in ~10m. :thumbsup:
sam: another angle: set env TEST_TIMER_JITTER_MS=1 to reduce false positives; helps triage but not a real fix. also try running under --run_under=tools/trace_wrapper to collect timeline.
ravi: ran bisect prepare: suspected PR range 2308..2350. if the smoke with patch fails to reduce rate, i'll bisect that range next.
ida: if we get a reproducible run, let's capture core and turn on thread sanitizer as well. also add a tiny reproducible unit that spins to expose the window.
alex_h: good plan. thx everyone — ping me if you get a 100% repro and i'll own the follow-up PR.
kevin: preliminary: 200 repeats -> 12 hits (before patch). after patch (notify_all+fence) -> 0 hits in 200. pushing patch to my branch for review and running CI.
ida: awesome, please open a draft PR and assign to @alex_h and @ida for quick review. once CI is green we'll backport to release-candidate. :raised_hands:
ci-bot: rerun job 4522 passed. job 4523 running with kevin/patch branch.
ravi: bisect on hold. will resume if kevin's patch doesn't hold in CI.
ida: closing loop — thanks team, will follow up in PR thread.
